scheme_name: Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing
description:
The scheme titled "Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing" was launched by the Government of Goa in 2021. 

This initiative aims to promote and preserve the rich cultural heritage of Goa, specifically focusing on the Konkani language and its associated art forms. 

The Konkani language is one of the 22 scheduled languages of India and is primarily spoken in the state of Goa. 

The scheme was introduced to encourage local artists and performers to showcase their talents in Konkani music and dance. 

One of the primary objectives of this scheme is to enhance the visibility and appreciation of Konkani songs and dances among the younger generation. 

The government aims to create a platform for local artists to perform and gain recognition for their work. 

The scheme also seeks to foster a sense of pride in the Konkani culture and heritage among the residents of Goa. 

The government has set a target to organize at least 50 cultural events annually under this scheme. 

These events will feature performances that highlight the beauty of Konkani music and dance. 

The scheme provides financial assistance to artists and groups participating in these events. 

Each selected group can receive a grant of up to INR 1 lakh for organizing performances. 

The assistance is aimed at covering costs related to costumes, choreography, and venue arrangements. 

Eligibility for this scheme is primarily focused on local artists and cultural groups based in Goa. 

Artists must be residents of Goa and should have a proven track record in performing Konkani music or dance. 

There are no specific age limits for applicants, allowing participation from both young and seasoned performers. 

However, groups must consist of a minimum of five members to qualify for financial assistance. 

The application process is straightforward and involves several steps. 

Interested artists or groups must submit an application form to the Department of Art and Culture, Government of Goa. 

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the Department of Art and Culture. 

Applicants are required to provide details about their performance, including a brief description of the choreography and music. 

Additionally, they must submit a video recording of a previous performance showcasing their skills. 

The application must also include a budget estimate for the proposed event. 

All applications are reviewed by a committee formed by the Department of Art and Culture. 

The committee evaluates the applications based on artistic merit and cultural significance. 

Successful applicants will be notified within 30 days of submission. 

Once approved, funds will be disbursed in two installments. 

The first installment of 50 percent will be released upon approval. 

The second installment will be released after the successful completion of the event. 

The scheme is designed to be flexible and can adapt to various forms of Konkani music and dance. 

This includes traditional folk dances such as Fugdi and Dhalo. 

It also encompasses modern interpretations and fusion performances that incorporate contemporary elements. 

The government has partnered with local cultural organizations to help promote this scheme. 

These organizations assist in organizing events and workshops aimed at training aspiring artists. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of educational programs related to Konkani music and dance. 

Workshops and training sessions will be conducted throughout the year. 

These sessions aim to educate participants about the history and significance of Konkani cultural practices. 

The Department of Art and Culture will also collaborate with schools and colleges to introduce Konkani music and dance into their curricula. 

This initiative is part of a broader effort to revitalize interest in regional languages and cultures across India. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 5 crore for this scheme for the financial year 2021-2022. 

This funding will support various activities including performances, workshops, and promotional events. 

The scheme is expected to significantly contribute to the local economy by boosting tourism. 

Cultural events organized under this scheme are anticipated to attract both local and international tourists. 

The government aims to promote Goa as a cultural hub through these initiatives. 

The scheme is also aligned with the "Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat" initiative. 

This national program promotes cultural integration and the celebration of India's diversity. 

The Department of Art and Culture has established a helpline for artists seeking information about the scheme. 

The helpline can be reached at the number provided on the official website. 

Artists are encouraged to utilize this resource for guidance on the application process. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from the local community since its inception. 

Many artists have expressed gratitude for the financial support and opportunities provided. 

The government plans to expand the scheme in the coming years based on its success. 

Future expansions may include collaborations with national and international artists. 

This would further enhance the reach and impact of Konkani music and dance. 

The scheme is an important step towards preserving and promoting Goa's unique cultural identity. 

It reflects the government's commitment to supporting local artists and fostering cultural pride. 

Overall, the "Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing" scheme is a significant initiative. 

It aims to uplift the Konkani arts and provide a sustainable platform for artists in Goa. 

Through this scheme, the government hopes to ensure that Konkani culture continues to thrive for generations to come.
